notes: ADMIN LOGIN (Part 1): chose a DEDICATED /admin/login route (not an inline form in AdminGuard) — AdminGuard reads authStorage.getUserRole() once at render, so a localStorage write from an inline form would NOT re-run the gate; a separate route means login success navigate('/admin') re-mounts the guard which then re-reads the freshly-stored SuperAdmin role. AdminGuard now redirects tokenless/non-SuperAdmin users to /admin/login (was /x/login — which structurally cannot mint a fleetless SuperAdmin token). adminLogin() added to client.ts: POST /auth/admin/login { email, password }, returns StaffLoginResponse (reused — same shape), skipAuthRedirect:true (same as verifyCustomerCode) so a 401 renders a form error instead of bouncing. useAdminLogin mirrors useLogin: 401->admin.login.invalidCredentials, success->authStorage.setTokens(access, refresh, '', 'SuperAdmin') then navigate('/admin'). EMPTY fleetSlug is deliberate: a SuperAdmin is fleetless, and an empty slug keeps getFleetSlug() falsy so no stale X-Fleet-Slug leaks onto the cross-tenant /admin/* calls (verified admin endpoints need no slug). AdminLoginPage mirrors the dispatcher LoginPage minus the slug field (email + password). New lazy route in router.tsx: /admin/login -> AdminLoginPage (separate entry before the /admin guard route). i18n: added admin.login.* to BOTH cs.json and en.json (title/email/emailPlaceholder/password/submit/loading/invalidCredentials/networkError/unknownError + validation.emailRequired/emailInvalid/passwordRequired) — parity test green. E2E SUPERADMIN AUTH (Part 2): added adminApiLogin(email,password) hitting POST /auth/admin/login (fleetless, no slug) and swapped the AC3 SuperAdmin step from the old apiLogin(...,NEW_FLEET.slug) to adminApiLogin — the blocker from B7c handoff #1 is resolved by laneA7b. The FleetAdmin login for the new fleet STAYS on apiLogin (POST /auth/staff/login with slug) — correct for a fleet-bound FleetAdmin. Rewrote the header comment block (lines 18-30) that described the now-resolved blocker. beforeAll create-superadmin CLI unchanged. SuperAdmin creds unchanged (superadmin@demo.local / Super1234!). Spec NOT run. FLEET-TAB CLOBBER FIX (Part 3): verified against api/.../GetFleetSettingsResponse.cs that GET /fleet/settings now returns PrimaryColorHex, WelcomeText, SmsMonthlyCapCzk (A7b) but NOT logoUrl. So: added primaryColorHex?/welcomeText? (string|null, optional for backward compat) to FleetSettingsDto; added both to FleetSettingsViewModel + mapFleetSettings passthrough. FleetTab now prefills color/welcome/smsCap from GET /fleet/settings DIRECTLY (removed the public/fleet color/welcome workaround AND the default-500 smsCap fallback-as-primary-source). getPublicFleet is RETAINED but ONLY for the logo preview (logoUrl is not in the settings read, and the logo is a separate 204 upload not part of the PUT, so it is orthogonal to the clobber risk — dropping it would silently regress the preview). The seed useEffect dep array dropped publicFleet. smsMonthlyCapCzk default 500 is now only the last-resort ?? fallback when settings omits it (it no longer will). WATCH-ITEM (pre-existing, out of scope, for the conductor): token EXPIRY on an /admin/* API call (not the login call) still falls through apiRequest's dispatcher branch and does window.location.href='/x/login', NOT /admin/login — a SuperAdmin whose token expires mid-session bounces to the dispatcher login. The task's 401 concern was the LOGIN call (handled correctly via skipAuthRedirect), and this fallthrough is pre-existing apiRequest behavior, so it was not changed. If the conductor wants /admin sessions to re-login cleanly, apiRequest needs a path-aware redirect (/admin/* -> /admin/login). TEST MOCKING: AdminLoginPage.test.tsx mocks the api client module via vi.mock (adminLogin: vi.fn()) per rules/web-testing.md#network-mocking — NOT fetch stubs. importOriginal spread is kept so ApiResponseError stays the real class (useAdminLogin narrows on instanceof). Mirrors the sibling AdminFleetsPage.test.tsx / FleetTab.test.tsx precedent.
